rationale: The plan matches the reference on every core point: raw QuantSeq counts go straight into DESeq2 Wald with ~condition and control as the explicit reference level, no length offset or TPM/FPKM anywhere, median-of-ratios normalization inside the model, a lowered floor of >=5 counts in >=3 samples with tested/significant/NA counts reported, BH at 0.05 with independent filtering and apeglm shrinkage. QC is a blind-VST PCA, distance heatmap, and library-size plot colored by condition with outliers flagged, though the handling policy once flagged is not spelled out. Enrichment was not requested, but the added fgsea step is fully specified (full ranked list by Wald stat, tested-gene universe, named Hallmark/Reactome collections, 15-500 window, versions in the report) and does not introduce a length correction, so it is an unneeded but not incorrect addition. The report step names method, versions, seed, design, thresholds, counts, and the n=3 power caveat.
